subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which canonical gateway session activity contract and Control UI scope should own the compact active-run progress surface requested here?
rationale: The requested UI needs public session semantics beyond current status and hasActiveRun, and the open related API/UI PRs do not yet settle the activity, attention, stale-run, child-rollup, and proof requirements.

options.title: Settle the gateway activity contract first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to define the sessions.activity API/event schema and then build the Control UI strip on top of it.

options.title: Narrow an open implementation PR
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96672 or the relevant parts of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92697 only after trimming scope and satisfying API/proof concerns.

options.title: Defer richer progress UI
options.body: Keep the current coarse status UI until maintainers are ready to own a public activity and attention-state contract.

recommendation.title: Settle the gateway activity contract first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to define the sessions.activity API/event schema and then build the Control UI strip on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical sessions.activity issue and is the best available owner for the public gateway/session contract decision.
